restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: Official matrix says descriptions do not list every ingredient; peanuts, tree nuts, shellfish and all other allergens are present in the kitchen and products cannot be guaranteed free of the nine major allergens.
Matrix contains a Kids Grilled Cheese Sesame Cross Contamination note and Portuguese Muffin factory statement naming egg, dairy, soy, and tree nuts.
